name: Los Alamos National Laboratory
description: Nuclear weapon design laboratory responsible for providing research, development, and manufacturing guidance authority; plutonium pit production.

name: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory
description: Nuclear weapon design laboratory responsible for providing research, development, and manufacturing guidance authority.

name: Sandia National Laboratories
description: Responsible for non-nuclear components of U.S. nuclear weapons; second campus at Livermore, California.

name: Kansas City National Security Campus
description: Procurement and manufacturing of non-nuclear components for nuclear weapons.

name: Pantex Plant
description: Nuclear weapon assembly, disassembly and high-explosive work; stockpile stewardship, nonproliferation, and safeguards and security missions.

name: Savannah River Site
description: Manages tritium inventories and facilities; planned plutonium pit production; H-Canyon reprocessing (see fissile layer).

name: Y-12 National Security Complex
description: Production or refurbishment of complex nuclear weapon components and secondaries; national HEU processing and storage.

name: Nevada National Security Site
description: Former nuclear test site; subcritical experiments, nuclear and radiological emergency response training, support to national security customers.
